The main painting is flanked on the left and right by wide, reddish-brown borders adorned with repeating gold floral patterns, primarily large peony blossoms. The top and bottom edges of the scroll feature narrower, dark green borders with intricate gold patterns. In the upper right quadrant of the painting, five vertical lines of black calligraphy are visible, reading from right to left: "白雲深處有仙家", "江上清風明月夜", "獨釣寒江雪", "玉壺冰心在", and "天涯共此時". A smaller, less distinct line of text and a red square seal are positioned below these lines. The background in this area is a light, hazy gray. The central and lower portions of the painting depict a vast, misty mountain landscape. Jagged, dark gray mountain peaks rise from a hazy mid-ground, with lighter, more distant peaks fading into the mist. Several prominent, gnarled pine trees with dense foliage are depicted on rocky ledges and slopes, particularly a large one in the mid-right. Other, more slender trees are scattered throughout the scene. A waterfall or stream appears to cascade down a central rock face. Small, dark-roofed structures, possibly temples or houses, are nestled among the trees and rocks, particularly in the lower-left and lower-right sections, with some appearing connected by small bridges over water. The foreground shows more detailed rocky terrain and water, with a sense of depth created by varying shades of gray and the suggestion of mist.

alt_text: Six robed figures on a patterned mat, some interacting, with boxes and a flask
long_description: The image features six figures depicted wearing various garments, seated on a light brown, textured mat that occupies the central portion of the frame. This central area is bordered by decorative patterns: a gold and brown floral design on the left and right, and a gold and blue pattern along the top and bottom edges.Starting from the upper left, a figure with dark hair styled in a high bun wears a white robe with wide sleeves featuring red and black patterns, and a gold-colored collar. This figure is seated with hands slightly raised, looking towards the center. To their right, a bare-chested figure with dark hair pulled back sits in a dark robe, with one leg bent and an arm resting on it. A dark hilt, possibly of a sword, is visible at their waist. This figure smiles, looking towards the right.In the lower left, a figure with dark hair, wearing a light blue-grey robe with gold accents, kneels and holds a dark, pear-shaped flask. This figure faces towards the center. In the middle of the group, on the ground, are three small, rectangular, gold-colored boxes with red floral designs on their lids, arranged in a horizontal line. A small, red, mushroom-shaped object is also visible near the boxes.To the right of the boxes, two figures are positioned closely. One figure, with a dark beard and dark hair, wears a dark robe and leans towards another figure. This second figure, with dark hair in a bun, wears a striped yellow and black garment with red accents, and smiles broadly while looking at the bearded figure. A sixth figure, also in a dark robe, is partially visible behind the bearded figure. The figures are depicted with delicate lines and a palette of muted colors, with subtle gold detailing on their clothing and the boxes.

alt_text: Six-panel screen with gold background, featuring rectangular inserts of landscapes and calligraphic text
long_description: A six-panel screen, presented horizontally, features a predominantly gold background. The gold background is textured with a speckled appearance and includes undulating forms in darker gold and brown, suggesting clouds, mist, or distant mountains. Ten rectangular inserts are arranged across the six panels. These inserts vary in size and orientation, with some being taller vertical rectangles and others wider horizontal ones. Five of the inserts depict detailed landscape scenes. These scenes feature elements such as green pine trees, small human figures, architectural structures like buildings with tiled roofs, and bridges over water. The colors in these landscape panels are muted, including greens, browns, and some light blues. For example, in the leftmost panel, a vertical insert shows a building with a fence and trees. In the second panel from the left, a vertical insert shows figures among trees and structures. The other five inserts are solid blocks of color, either a muted red or a muted green, and contain visible calligraphic text. The text is written in vertical columns. For instance, in the leftmost panel, a green rectangular insert with text is positioned above a landscape scene, and a red rectangular insert with text is to its right. This pattern of alternating landscape and text panels, often with a red or green background, continues across the screen.

alt_text: Six-panel artwork showing a large gathering, horse racing, spectators, and a winding river
long_description: The six-panel artwork features a warm, light brown background, depicting a lively outdoor scene with numerous figures. The composition is broadly divided into three horizontal registers, with a prominent dark, winding river flowing vertically on the far left.In the upper left panel, a large brown tree with green foliage stands beside the dark river. Below the tree, several figures in colorful robes are gathered near the riverbank, some seated, some standing. A small, simple wooden bridge crosses the river further down. Moving right across the top register, elevated platforms and buildings are filled with many figures, mostly seated, observing the activities below. These spectators wear a variety of robes in colors such as white, green, red, and blue, with some seated under canopies.The middle register, below the elevated platforms, shows more figures on the ground. A long, horizontal wooden fence or barrier extends across the lower half of the middle register. Above this barrier, several figures are depicted on horseback, some holding spears or bows, with their horses in dynamic poses. Other figures are seated or standing on the ground, observing these equestrian activities.In the bottom register, below the horizontal barrier, a procession or race of horses and riders continues. The horses are adorned with colorful blankets and decorations, and their riders wear elaborate, multi-colored costumes. Scattered figures on foot, both seated and standing, are also present in this lower section, observing the horse-related events. Gold accents are visible on some clothing, horse decorations, and architectural details throughout the painting.

alt_text: Two panels show a snowy mountain landscape, a house, a boat, and a golden sky
long_description: The artwork is a two-panel painting depicting a winter landscape. The upper half of the composition is dominated by towering, snow-covered mountains rendered in shades of white and light gray, with dark outlines defining their contours. In the lower left panel, a building with a dark, gabled roof and light-colored walls is nestled on a rocky, snow-covered shoreline. Dense, snow-laden trees and bushes with dark branches are clustered around the building. A small red seal mark is visible in the bottom left corner of this panel. The right panel features a wide expanse of calm, light gray water, likely a lake or bay, stretching across the lower and middle sections. A small, flat-bottomed boat with a covered cabin and a single figure at the stern, holding an oar, floats on the water. In the far distance, a range of smaller, snow-capped mountains extends across the horizon. A pale, circular light source, possibly a moon or a low sun, is visible between these distant peaks. The sky above the mountains and water is a warm, muted golden-yellow, providing a soft contrast to the cool tones of the snow and water.

alt_text: A white egret with outstretched wings descends towards its reflection in water, surrounded by reeds
long_description: The image is a vertical scroll painting featuring a white egret over water, set against a light golden-tan background. The egret, positioned in the upper half of the central panel, is depicted with its wings spread wide, positioned as if in mid-descent or ascent. Its body is angled downwards, and its long neck is curved, with its beak pointing towards the water below. Its long, slender legs are bent, with its feet tucked beneath its body. The bird's plumage is rendered in shades of white and light gray, with delicate brushstrokes suggesting individual feathers. Below the egret, in the lower half of the central panel, a faint reflection of the bird is visible in the pale, slightly darker tan area of water. The reflection shows the bird's body, wings, and legs, mirroring its pose above. To the right of the reflection, a cluster of tall, thin, dark green reeds rises from the water, with a few smaller, lighter green plants at their base. The central golden-tan panel is framed by two decorative fabric borders. The inner border, at the top and bottom, is a narrow strip of gold-colored fabric with a subtle, repeating floral or geometric pattern. The outer borders, running vertically along the left and right sides, are wider strips of teal-blue fabric. This teal fabric features a pattern of stylized white waves and small, gold-colored fish or scales. In the bottom right corner of the central panel, there is a vertical column of dark calligraphic text, followed by a red square seal.

Several trees with dark green foliage and light brown trunks are scattered across gently rolling hills in the foreground. On the far left, a small, light-colored building with a dark roof is nestled among these trees on a low slope. In the distance, on the left, faint, blue-gray mountain peaks emerge from the mist. Below the feet, three main figures are depicted: a central seated figure in orange and white, a seated figure in white robes with long hair to its left, and another seated figure in white robes to its right. He holds a small child in a green robe on his left and another small child in a light pink robe on his right, both with small halos. To the central figure's left, three men are seated: one in a blue robe, one with a white beard in a light gray robe, and one in a brown robe, all wearing white turbans. To his right, three men are seated: one in a brown robe with a halo, one in a dark teal robe, and one in a light gray robe, all wearing white turbans. In the foreground, three men are seated with their backs to the viewer: one in a brown robe, one in a white robe, and one in a light gray robe, all with white turbans. The background features a light-colored architectural structure with multiple arched niches and columns. Faint script is visible within the arches and on the rug. Visible text includes: "نور چشم حضرت آدم", "نور چشم حضرت نوح", "نور چشم حضرت ابراهیم", "نور چشم حضرت موسی", "نور چشم حضرت عیسی", "علی بن ابی طالب", "حسن", "حسین", "زین العابدین", "محمد باقر", "جعفر صادق", and "موسی کاظم".

alt_text: A robed figure writes on a scroll, with calligraphy, a colorful bird, and a flowering branch
long_description: The artwork is a rectangular composition featuring a central light beige panel set against a wider, light tan background with blue borders at the top and bottom. Above the central panel, a branch with green leaves and small white flowers extends from the upper-left corner. To the right of the branch, a large, colorful bird with a long, flowing tail is depicted, facing right. Its feathers are rendered in shades of gold, green, and blue. The light tan background in this upper section also contains subtle gold patterns. The central light beige panel occupies the majority of the artwork's width. On the left side of this panel, several vertical lines of black calligraphy are present. On the right side, a bald figure, dressed in a simple robe, is seated on the ground, facing left. The figure holds a brush and appears to be writing on a long, unrolled scroll or piece of paper laid out in front of them. To the left of the seated figure is a small, black, pedestal-like stand with a dark object on top. To the right of the figure, two rectangular objects are stacked vertically, and next to them is a red square seal with black characters. The bottom section of the artwork, below the central panel, mirrors the upper section's light tan background with subtle gold patterns, and is framed by a blue border at the very bottom.

alt_text: A standing figure in a white kimono with red, green, and blue circular patterns, holding a fan
long_description: A full-length painting on a vertical scroll shows a standing figure against a plain, light beige background. The figure, positioned slightly right of center, faces forward with their head tilted down and to the right. They have light skin and black hair styled in an elaborate bun with a white, rectangular ornament. The figure wears a long, flowing white kimono with wide sleeves. The kimono is adorned with a pattern of large, stylized circular motifs in red, green, and light blue, interspersed with swirling red lines and tassels. Some circles contain smaller concentric circles or floral patterns. A black and white checkerboard patterned sash cinches the waist, and a red collar is visible beneath the white kimono. The figure's left arm is bent, holding a fan or similar object partially obscured by the sleeve. Their right arm is mostly hidden by the voluminous kimono. The figure's feet, visible at the bottom, wear white footwear with red trim.

alt_text: A woman in a patterned kimono holds a fan, standing beside a stringed instrument
long_description: The image shows a standing woman on a plain, light tan background. The woman is positioned slightly to the right of the center, facing left with her head tilted downwards. Her black hair is styled elaborately, adorned with multiple thin, golden, spiky ornaments radiating from the back of her head, and a red floral ornament near her left ear. Her face is pale, and her eyes are downcast. She wears a long, flowing kimono. The main body of the kimono is a muted purple-grey, with a cream-colored collar and red lining visible at the sleeves and hem. The lower portion of the kimono is decorated with a pattern of green leafy vines and small blue flowers. Her left arm is bent, holding a light-colored, closed fan with dark ribs. Her right hand holds a length of light cream-colored fabric that drapes down her front. To the lower left of the woman, a long, multi-stringed instrument rests on a low, red stand. A small blue object, possibly a book, and a piece of white paper are placed on the ground near the instrument. To the left of the woman's waist, a vertical column of black calligraphic text reads "春の夜の夢", followed by a red seal. The entire painting is framed by a decorative border with vertical stripes of gold, blue, and cream patterns.

alt_text: Two women in patterned garments, one balancing a dark object on her head, on a decorated scroll
long_description: The artwork is a vertical scroll painting featuring two women against a plain background, framed by decorative borders. The background behind the figures is a solid, light tan color. The woman on the left stands slightly taller and is positioned slightly behind the woman on the right. She wears a light blue-grey kimono with a red lining visible at the sleeves and hem, and a dark green obi. Her right hand is raised, holding a dark, rounded, basket-like object on top of her head. Her left arm is bent, with her hand near her waist. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo. The woman on the right wears a dark, possibly black or deep blue, kimono with a vibrant red and gold patterned lining visible at the sleeves and collar. She has a dark obi. Her left hand holds a small, dark, flat, rectangular object at her side. Her right hand is partially obscured by her sleeve. Her hair is also styled in an elaborate updo. Both women have pale complexions and dark hair. The scroll is bordered by a wide, light brown fabric with a repeating pattern of small, circular motifs in red, blue, and white. At the top, there is a wider band of gold fabric with a repeating pattern of two large, symmetrical, stylized motifs that resemble mythical creatures or elaborate floral designs. A similar wide band of gold fabric with a pattern of green and brown stylized pine branches or clouds is present at the bottom of the scroll.

alt_text: A tall, misty mountain, dense forests, terraced hills, and a small bridge in an ink wash landscape
long_description: The vertical ink wash painting, rendered in shades of black and gray on a light-colored ground, is framed by a dark green border with a patterned gold-colored inner edge. At the top, a prominent, pointed mountain rises, its peak softly blurred by what appears to be mist or clouds. To its left, a smaller, rounded hill is visible. Below these peaks, a dense band of dark, textured trees stretches across the mid-ground. Further down, a body of water with several small, irregular landforms or islands is depicted. Below the water, the landscape transitions into a series of terraced or stepped hillsides, rendered with distinct horizontal lines and varying shades of ink. Scattered among these are individual trees and small clusters of foliage. In the lower left foreground, a cluster of tall, slender trees with full, dark canopies stands prominently. To the right, a small, arched bridge spans a narrow waterway. In the upper left corner of the painting, vertical characters "三峰" are visible, accompanied by a small, square red seal below them.

alt_text: A black bird, pink chrysanthemums, and a dark rock formation on a vertical scroll
long_description: A vertical scroll painting displays a black bird, pink flowers, and a dark rock formation on a light cream background. At the top, a black bird with a white belly and tail feathers is depicted in mid-flight, descending towards the right. Below the bird, a large, round pink chrysanthemum with many petals is positioned. To its right, vertical black text and two small red square seals are visible. Below the chrysanthemum, a cluster of smaller pink flowers with elongated leaves extends vertically. A large, jagged dark gray and black rock formation runs diagonally from the upper right to the lower left, partially obscured by the pink flowers. More pink flowers and light green stems are visible around and behind the rock. Near the bottom center, a small red square seal is present. The painting is framed by a dark green border with gold scrollwork patterns at the top and bottom, and a lighter green textured border along the sides.

Their right arm is extended forward and slightly down, while their left hand is held near their chest. They wear a light-colored, flowing garment, possibly a kimono, with subtle green and blue tints, cinched at the waist by a patterned obi in shades of red and white. A small, light-colored cap or head covering sits atop their dark hair, which is styled in a bun at the back of their head. alt_text: Three mice on and around a red table with books, peacock feathers, and coral
long_description: A vertical composition features a light beige background framed by patterned borders at the top and bottom. The top border features a repeating floral motif in muted blues, browns, and greens. In the upper left quadrant of the main beige area, a column of black calligraphic text is present with two red square seals beneath it. Below this, on the left side, a slender, light-colored vase holds several long peacock feathers and a branch of red coral. The peacock feathers are dark green and brown with prominent iridescent "eye" spots. The coral is a vibrant red, branching upwards. In the lower half of the composition, a red, four-legged table with a slightly raised edge is depicted. On the tabletop, a stack of blue-covered books is visible, with a lighter-colored, open book resting beside them. Two small, grey-brown mice are positioned on the table. One mouse stands on the stack of blue books, facing right, while the other is to its left, appearing to interact with the open book. Below the table, a third mouse is partially visible, peeking out from behind a stack of loose papers or unbound books. Another blue-covered book lies on the floor beneath the table. The bottom border mirrors the floral pattern of the top border.

alt_text: Vertical ink painting of large, dark leaves with circular water drops, framed by a gold border
long_description: A vertical ink painting depicts several large leaves on a light paper background, framed by a patterned gold border. The leaves are rendered in varying shades of gray and black ink, showing prominent veins and a slightly textured surface. Numerous circular and oval shapes, representing water drops, are visible on the leaf surfaces, depicted as lighter areas that contrast with the darker ink of the leaves. A central, twisted stem or stalk runs vertically through the middle of the composition. The leaves overlap, creating a sense of depth. In the upper right portion of the painting, there are red seals and black calligraphic characters.

alt_text: Towering mountains, dense trees, and a cascading waterfall in a rugged landscape
long_description: A vertical landscape depicts a rugged mountain scene with a cascading waterfall and dense trees. Towering, jagged peaks dominate the upper half, rendered in varying shades of black and grey, with subtle hints of light reddish-brown on some rock faces. Areas of lighter grey and white appear as mist or clouds swirling around the mid-sections of the mountains, and a faint blue wash is visible in the upper right background. In the upper right corner, black calligraphic characters read "未米" above a square red seal. Below the highest peaks, a dense forest of trees, primarily dark green and black, covers the steep slopes. A prominent waterfall descends through the center, appearing as a light, almost white, streak against the darker rock and foliage, flowing over multiple rocky ledges. In the lower half, more trees with visible light brown trunks and branches are scattered across the lower slopes and at the base of the mountains. The brushwork varies from fine lines for delicate branches to broad, textured washes for rock formations and dense foliage.

alt_text: Numerous figures along a winding river in a misty, mountainous landscape with a pavilion
long_description: A verdant landscape features a winding river flowing through it, populated by numerous small figures. At the top, green and brown mountains rise, partially obscured by white mist. Below these mountains, a waterfall cascades down a steep, green hillside into the river. On the right bank of the river, a pavilion with a dark, multi-tiered roof and red pillars stands, surrounded by trees, some bearing pink blossoms. The light blue-green river meanders from the upper middle section downwards. Along its banks, dozens of small figures, predominantly dressed in blue robes, are seated or standing on the grassy slopes. They are arranged in small groups, some facing each other, others facing the river. Small, dark objects, possibly cups, float in the river, particularly in the middle section. A white, bird-like form floats in the river near the pavilion. The landscape includes various trees and foliage, with tall bamboo groves on the left bank. Towards the bottom, the river flows under a light-colored arched bridge on the right side. More figures are scattered on the lower banks. In the lower left corner, vertical lines of black text are visible, accompanied by a square red seal. Another square red seal is present in the lower right corner.

alt_text: Vertical ink painting of a vast mountainous landscape with trees, houses, and calligraphic text
long_description: This vertical ink painting on light paper depicts a detailed mountainous landscape. At the top, a large, craggy mountain range dominates the left side, rendered with dark ink washes and textured strokes, suggesting rocky formations and sparse vegetation. Several small, simple buildings with tiled roofs are nestled into the mountainside on the upper left. To the right of these prominent peaks, the landscape recedes into a valley with softer, more distant mountains and hills, depicted with lighter ink. In the upper right quadrant, multiple columns of black calligraphic text, written in a script that is not legible at this resolution, cover a significant portion of the sky and distant landscape. Below the main mountain range, a dense forest fills the middle ground, featuring various types of trees. Some trees have thick, rounded canopies, while others show slender trunks and delicate branches. More buildings are visible on the left, integrated into the forested slopes. The lower half of the painting is filled with a dense, textured pattern of foliage, suggesting a thick undergrowth or a vast expanse of trees extending into the foreground. The overall palette is monochromatic, primarily black ink on a light, possibly aged, paper.

alt_text: Towering mountains, a cascading waterfall, dense trees, a small building, and an arched bridge
long_description: The vertical ink painting on light-colored paper depicts a mountainous landscape rendered primarily in black and gray ink washes with subtle reddish-brown accents. A massive, craggy mountain dominates the upper right and central portion of the composition, appearing to have a waterfall cascading down its face, indicated by lighter vertical streaks. Below the main peak, a dense cluster of tall, slender trees with sparse branches rises from a sloping hillside. To the left of these trees, a small, two-story building with a dark roof is nestled on a lower slope. Further down and to the right, a small, arched bridge spans a narrow stream or river, with more trees scattered on the surrounding banks. In the upper left quadrant, a column of black calligraphic text is present, reading: "不從泉源路半枯 山骨灣冷、樹湯影 層峰一年有經 戊己真年十月寫春琴". Below and to the left of the text are several red seal impressions. The background features lighter, less defined mountain forms, suggesting depth.

alt_text: Tall, narrow ink painting of a mountain landscape with waterfalls, bare trees, and small figures
long_description: A tall, narrow image rendered in ink on light brown paper depicts a monochromatic landscape with subtle tonal variations. The composition is dominated by towering mountains and dense forests, depicted from a high vantage point. In the upper section, a series of softly contoured mountains rise, their peaks fading into the distance. A narrow, multi-tiered waterfall cascades down from a cleft between two peaks on the left, flowing into a valley. Sparse, bare trees with delicate branches dot the upper slopes and ridges. As the eye moves downward, the landscape becomes more densely forested. Jagged mountain forms and steep cliffs emerge on the right, textured with vertical brushstrokes. The middle ground is filled with a thick canopy of leafless trees, their intricate, gnarled branches forming a complex network. A winding path or stream is suggested through the dense foliage. In the lower section, the trees are even more prominent and detailed, with a variety of trunk shapes and branch patterns. On the lower right, nestled among rocks and trees, two small figures are visible. One figure appears to be seated, while the other stands nearby, both facing towards the left. A faint red seal is visible near the figures, and a column of vertical text is present in the upper right quadrant of the painting.

alt_text: Towering mountains, dense pine trees, a cascading waterfall, buildings, and a figure by a winding stream
long_description: A vertical landscape, rendered primarily in shades of black, gray, and muted greens and browns on a light beige background, depicts a vast mountainous scene. The upper half is dominated by towering, craggy mountains with textured brushstrokes suggesting rocky surfaces and sparse foliage, receding into a lighter, misty background. In the mid-ground, a waterfall cascades down the right side of a central mountain. Below it, a cluster of buildings with reddish-brown roofs is nestled among dense pine trees. Further up and to the left, another group of buildings is visible on a higher mountain slope. The foreground features a winding stream or river, with a small figure in a reddish-brown robe seated on the bank to the left of the stream, facing right. More large pine trees with dark green needles and brown trunks frame the lower part of the scene, particularly on the left. Several small, simple buildings with reddish-brown roofs are visible on stilts along the stream's edge on the right. In the upper left, vertical text in black ink reads: "匡山沈學" followed by "高山仰止" and "丁丑年冬月寫於" and then "清溪草堂". Below this text, there is a red square seal.

alt_text: A man in ornate clothing sits with two figures, a harbor view, and decorative borders
long_description: A vertical rectangular painting depicts a man seated in a room, framed by multiple decorative borders. The central figure, a man with light skin, a mustache, and a small beard, sits on a light green chair, looking towards the viewer's left. He wears a red and gold hat, a gold jacket with red trim, and red trousers. A sword with a blue scabbard is tucked into his sash. To his left, two smaller figures are seated on the floor, facing the main figure. One wears a red and gold outfit, the other a green and gold outfit. Behind the main figure, a large window or opening reveals a harbor scene with a body of water, a distant island, and several boats under a light blue sky with white clouds. To the main figure's right, a light blue curtain is draped, and a small, ornate wooden table with drawers holds a vase of flowers and other small objects. The central scene is enclosed by a black frame with gold floral patterns. This is surrounded by a wide border with a light blue-grey background covered in intricate red, green, and gold floral and geometric patterns. The outermost border features alternating red and gold sections with small decorative elements, finished with a thin red line.

alt_text: Woman in a white shawl, gold jewelry, and ornate headpiece, against a cloudy background
long_description: A half-length portrait depicts a dark-skinned woman, positioned slightly to the right of the center, looking towards the upper right. Her dark hair is pulled back, adorned with a light-colored headpiece featuring three circular, decorative elements across the top of her head. She has dark eyes, a small nose, and full lips. Her ears are decorated with gold-colored earrings, each composed of multiple small, flat discs. Around her neck are three strands of gold-colored beads, and a longer necklace hangs lower, featuring a light pink, triangular pendant. She wears a white garment with a ruffled collar, covered by a voluminous white shawl draped over her shoulders and arms. alt_text: Three gold-toned panels show draped figures, winged beings, a lyre, and a snake-entwined staff.

Each panel has a gold background and is bordered by a decorative band with a leafy wreath pattern at the top and a wave pattern at the bottom. The dark wooden frame itself is adorned with small, gold, star-like embellishments at the corners and along the top and bottom edges. The left panel shows a standing female figure draped in light, flowing, peach-colored fabric. Her arms are raised, with her hands near her head, possibly holding a garland. At her feet, a smaller, nude figure, possibly a child, bends over a dark vessel. The central panel features three main standing figures and two smaller winged figures. On the left, a figure draped in dark teal stands, looking towards the right, holding what appears to be a scroll or tablet. In the center, a figure draped in dark brown is seated, looking downwards, holding a lyre or similar stringed instrument. This central figure wears a wreath on their head. On the right, a figure draped in red stands, looking towards the left. Above the seated central figure, two winged beings with light blue and gold wings float. Flanking the seated figure are two decorative pedestals; the left one has a snake coiled around a staff, and the right one supports a small plant. The right panel displays a standing female figure in light brown and gold drapery. Her arms are raised, holding a shallow bowl or plate above her head. A smaller, nude figure, possibly a child, stands at her feet, looking up at her, and appears to hold a bow or staff.

alt_text: Vertical ink wash landscape depicts towering mountains, misty valleys, dense trees, waterfalls, and small buildings
long_description: This vertical scroll painting, rendered primarily in ink wash with subtle green and brown accents, depicts a grand mountainous landscape. The upper third of the composition features towering, craggy mountains, their peaks fading into a soft, misty background, creating a sense of receding distance. In the upper right quadrant, a block of vertical text in black ink is visible, accompanied by several red seals. The text reads: "右有書 一常懷抱此景 溪水門道遙 追遠松枝手 看元處中 中而生 小可此不 庚午年". Below the highest peaks, the landscape becomes more densely vegetated. Numerous trees with dark green and brown foliage cling to the steep slopes and cluster along the banks of a winding river or lake. Several waterfalls cascade down the mountainsides, their white streaks contrasting with the darker rock. Small, traditional-style buildings with tiled roofs are nestled within the landscape; one is perched on a cliff edge in the middle ground, and another is situated closer to the water on the right. The lower portion of the painting features the calm body of water and more rocky, tree-covered terrain. The overall palette is dominated by shades of grey and black ink, with muted greens for foliage and light browns for the structures. The painting is bordered by a patterned gold fabric.

alt_text: A crowded scene of human and monstrous figures in a mountainous landscape
long_description: A vertical ink wash painting, rendered in black ink on light-colored paper, depicts a dense gathering of diverse figures within a mountainous landscape. To the right of the village, vertical black ink text is present, followed by two red square seals. The upper-mid section features several large figures. On the left, a spiky-haired, round-faced figure with a wide grin sits, looking towards a bearded, human-like figure with a prominent nose and open mouth, who is seated at a low table with an open book. To their right, another figure with a covered head reads from a small book, while an adjacent figure holds a large fan. Below this central group, the scene becomes more crowded. A large, round-eyed, whiskered creature with a beak-like mouth is on the far left. Further right, a figure rides a small, shaggy animal. Numerous other figures, some with animalistic features like beaks or horns, are scattered throughout, engaged in various activities, including looking at books or scrolls. The lowest part of the image shows smaller figures, some appearing as children or imps, amidst swirling lines that suggest water or clouds. A bird-like creature is also visible at the very bottom right. The figures are rendered with expressive brushstrokes, varying in thickness and intensity.

Further down, a series of pavilions with dark roofs and light-colored walls are connected by bridges over a stream or river. Small figures can be seen near these structures and on paths. This figure wears a blue garment and has red ribbons or flame-like elements emanating from its head. The main composition consists of five rows of seated figures. The first four rows each contain three figures, while the bottom row has two figures on the left and one on the right, totaling fourteen figures in this section. All figures in these rows are seated on lotus pedestals, which vary in color from pink and red to blue and green. Each figure has a dark halo behind their head. The figures display a range of skin tones, including dark brown, light brown, and white. Their garments are rendered in various colors such as red, white, blue, and green. Some figures wear elaborate crowns or headpieces, while others have simpler hair arrangements. Hand gestures and objects held by the figures also vary; some figures hold small vessels or have hands positioned in specific gestures. The figure at the bottom right is distinct, depicted with dark skin, seated on a multi-tiered red and gold pedestal, and surrounded by a red, flame-like aura.

To the right of the moon, a dark, imposing cliff face descends from the top edge, its surface textured with rugged lines. Gnarled, dark trees with intricate branches and hanging, moss-like foliage cling to the cliff face, extending towards the center. Below the cliff and across the upper mid-ground, a wide expanse of water stretches into the distance. Hazy, dark outlines of distant mountains or hills are visible on the far bank, interspersed with sparse, dark, pointed trees. The figure in the front is smaller, facing away from the viewer, with their back towards the larger figure. The larger figure, seated towards the stern, has a prominent beard and is looking towards the left. Both figures wear simple, light-colored robes. The rocky bank beneath the boat is rendered with dark, textured strokes and features some spiky, dark foliage. One of its left hands holds a black disc with four white dots. The smaller, green-skinned figure is held upside down by the large figure's lower two arms, its head hanging downwards to the left. This figure has black hair and wears a dark blue garment. Its limbs appear bound or wrapped with thin white lines. The background is a plain, light cream color. The background is a uniform, light brown, enclosed by a thick red border with a thin blue inner line, forming an arch at the top.

alt_text: Numerous figures harvesting and processing tea leaves under thatched roofs

They wear kimonos in shades of brown, orange, and blue, often with white or patterned head coverings. Below them, two men are seated on the ground, processing leaves. One man in a dark brown kimono holds a small bowl, while another in a blue patterned kimono works over a large, cylindrical container wrapped in bamboo, filled with green leaves. A second similar container sits nearby. In the central area, more women are picking leaves from the dense green bushes. A tall, slender pole supports one of the thatched roofs, and a young woman in a dark patterned kimono with a red sash peeks out from behind it, under the roof's edge. Towards the right, an open pathway leads away from the tea bushes. Two figures, both in blue kimonos, walk towards the right edge; one carries a small child on their back. In the lower right corner, two men appear to be engaged with documents. One man, standing in a blue striped kimono and a brown outer garment, holds a sheet of paper. Next to him, a man kneels, opening a black lacquered box that contains several books or scrolls. The overall color palette includes various greens for the foliage, with earth tones, blues, browns, oranges, and purples for the clothing and structures. The left panel is filled with dense black calligraphic text arranged in vertical columns, covering most of the panel's surface. The characters are rendered in varying strokes and sizes, creating a dynamic visual texture. Three red square seals are visible within this panel: one large seal at the bottom left corner, and two smaller seals positioned near the top right and bottom right of the text block. The right panel features an ink wash landscape painting. A prominent, dark gray mountain or cliff face dominates the right side of this panel, extending from the top edge to the bottom. Its surface is textured with vertical brushstrokes, suggesting rugged terrain. In the lower-middle section, three slender, dark green pine-like trees grow from a rocky outcrop, their trunks curving slightly to the left and their needles depicted with fine, feathery strokes. A lighter, misty area or body of water occupies the upper left portion of the panel, with a faint, horizontal line suggesting a distant horizon. Several red square seals are scattered across this panel. In the upper left corner, there is a small red seal, with faint black text above and to its right reading "春峰", "小山", "右谷", and "尊人". Along the right edge of the cliff face, another red seal is present, with black text above it reading "故宮監製許陽". Two more red seals are stacked vertically in the lower left corner of the panel. The overall color palette is limited to black, various shades of gray, and the red of the seals, against the light beige of the paper.

alt_text: Horizontal manuscript page with gold text, a central illustration of a reclining figure and animals
long_description: The image presents a horizontal manuscript page, divided into three distinct vertical sections. The left section features gold script on a red background, bordered by intricate blue and red floral and scrollwork designs. A small gold disc is embedded within the left border. The text reads: "परागधीर्माणामेवमायुरुक्तं पासेवेवनेमंगलेसमितिमयच्छुद मिणपामिताएंगिबुद्धाउत्तंकद मीहयसिमिसयदमसिमिसिद्धयए उममरसागरविमासयवरायए रत्तएणसादेवांदामहाणितेस त्तत्तमिणपामिसिद्धाहिबुद्धिम". The central section is a narrow, light-colored vertical strip, containing a prominent gold circle at its center, flanked by symmetrical blue decorative motifs. The right section is a vibrant illustration set against a red background, similarly framed by blue and red decorative borders. This illustrated section is further subdivided horizontally. The upper portion depicts a procession of animals, including two white elephants, a white horse, and a spotted leopard, all moving towards the right. Above these animals, a multi-armed, seated figure is visible. The lower portion of the illustration shows a dark-skinned figure reclining on a patterned couch. The figure wears a blue and green garment with gold accents and is adorned with elaborate gold jewelry, including large circular earrings and a crown. Their head rests on a pillow to the left, and their body is angled towards the right. Surrounding the reclining figure are various objects, such as a blue and white circular emblem, a golden vessel, and other small, golden items. The couch features a white and red patterned mattress and golden, ornate legs. The script in the middle text panel, also gold on red, reads: "रालकक्षा समदाक्षत गयवसह जयंकंप जयसिह मिणपासद पंदियापि".

On the far right side of the branch, a cluster of small, dark, round berries is visible. The bird and branch are placed in the lower half of the frame, leaving the upper right portion of the background empty. The figure wears pale, flowing robes that gather in soft folds and sits upon a multi-tiered, ornate pedestal in shades of dark red and gold. Directly below the central figure, on either side of the pedestal, are two smaller, similarly pale-skinned figures, also seated with legs crossed and facing forward, each with a halo and pale robes. The figure on the left is partially obscured by a staff-like object with a red banner. The lower half of the painting is densely populated with numerous smaller figures, varying in size, color, and posture. These figures include human-like forms and stylized beings with features such as red skin, multiple arms, or elaborate headdresses. They are arranged in a dense, varied composition, with some appearing to float or fly, and others standing or kneeling. The background is a muted green-brown, and the figures are rendered in reds, blues, greens, and browns, with gold accents. The entire composition is framed by a wide, vertical border on the left and right, featuring a repeating pattern of golden floral motifs against a dark background, with narrower horizontal gold borders at the top and bottom. At the very top, a small, stylized, winged motif in red and gold is visible, with several faint circular elements below it.

Above the woman's head, two winged putti with light skin and blue-grey wings appear to place a golden crown on her. She has long brown hair, wears a green tunic, a red robe, and a blue head covering. Her bare feet are visible. She extends her hands, holding a white chalice, towards the infant. To the right, a male figure stands on the lower steps. He has dark, curly hair and a beard, and is partially draped in a red cloth, exposing his chest and legs. His bare feet are also visible. He holds a tall, slender staff with a cross at its top in his left hand. A white scroll is wrapped around the staff, displaying the partial text "ECC... DEI". The background is a flat golden-yellow wall, with darker vertical strips on the far left and right edges, suggesting architectural pilasters.

alt_text: Two panels: a crucifixion scene on the left, a divine judgment scene on the right
long_description: This artwork, framed in a reddish-brown border, presents two vertical panels. The left panel shows a scene of three figures on crosses against a pale blue and green sky. The central figure, larger than the others, wears a white loincloth, with a plaque above their head reading "INRI". Two smaller figures, one with a white loincloth and the other with a dark one, hang on crosses to the central figure's left and right. Below them, a dense crowd of figures on horseback and foot fills the mid-ground, many in colorful garments of red, blue, green, and purple. Spears and banners extend upwards. In the foreground, a group of figures is depicted. A woman in a blue robe leans into the arms of another woman in a dark robe. A woman in a green dress kneels with outstretched arms. A distant town and hills are visible in the background under a pale sky with a crescent moon. The right panel is divided into three main sections. At the top, a central figure sits on a rainbow, wearing a deep red robe, with a golden orb beneath their feet. This figure is surrounded by winged figures and other robed figures, including a woman in a blue robe and a man in a green robe. Winged figures blow trumpets. Below the central figure, a large crowd of figures, some in white shrouds and others in monastic robes, rise from the earth, looking upwards. In the middle section, a large, dark, winged creature with a skull-like head and bat-like wings stands over a chasm, holding a shield and a sword. The bottom section depicts a chaotic scene filled with numerous naked figures interacting with grotesque, dark-colored, monstrous creatures. Fires are visible, and various forms of physical interaction are shown, including a large, monstrous creature devouring figures. Faint text is visible along the top and bottom edges of both panels' frames.

original_record.long_description: The image is a black and white photograph of an oval-shaped portrait set within an ornate oval frame. An inner, plain oval border, lighter in tone, separates the ornate frame from the central portrait. The portrait itself depicts a woman from the waist up, seated and facing slightly to the viewer's right, with her gaze directed forward. She wears a dark, high-necked, long-sleeved dress. A light-colored cap covers her hair, which appears to be pulled back. Her face is oval-shaped, with light-toned skin, light eyes, a straight nose, and a small mouth, conveying a serious expression. Her right hand rests on a stack of papers or a book held in her lap, and she holds a pen or pencil. The background behind her is a light, cloudy sky.

alt_text: A standing woman in a kimono holds a white object, another seated at a low table
long_description: The artwork depicts a scene with two women in traditional attire, set against a light, speckled background. The main panel is on the right, with a partial panel visible on the far left. In the central panel, a woman stands on the left, facing right, dressed in a dark blue kimono with a white floral pattern and a green outer garment. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo with dark ornaments. She holds a long, flowing white object, possibly a wig or a piece of fabric, which extends downwards. Several tiny, colorful figures, appearing to be children or small dolls, are depicted interacting with this white object, some climbing on it, others near its base. One small figure in red is visible near the standing woman's waist. To the right, another woman is seated on the floor, facing left, dressed in a teal-green kimono with a patterned hem and a purple inner garment. Her hair is also styled in an elaborate updo with golden, spiky ornaments. She holds a small white piece of paper in her hands, looking down at it. In front of her is a low, rectangular black table with a yellow surface patterned with red flowers. On the table are various items, including a red container, a brush, and other small objects. A fan lies on the floor near her. The background of this central panel is a light beige or cream color, with a fine, speckled texture. A red seal with black characters, appearing to read "春信", is visible near the bottom left of this panel. To the far left, a portion of another panel is visible, showing the trunk of a light-colored tree with delicate pink blossoms. Below the tree, a red and blue object, possibly part of a palanquin or carriage, is partially visible. The right edge of the central panel is bordered by a vertical strip of gold-colored paper with a repeating geometric pattern in dark blue.

alt_text: Ink wash painting of a man with a long white beard holding a small spherical object
long_description: A tall, narrow scroll displays an ink wash painting of a man, framed by decorative borders. The outermost borders are a light gold fabric with a subtle, repeating pattern of stylized flowers and foliage. Inside this, a narrower band of light gold fabric displays a geometric lattice pattern. The central painting, rendered in shades of black and grey ink on a light ground, depicts a man from the chest up, positioned slightly to the right of the vertical center. He has a bald head with a dark topknot of hair at the back, prominent white eyebrows, and a long, flowing white beard that reaches his chest. His face shows visible wrinkles. He wears a loose-fitting robe with wide sleeves, outlined in dark ink and filled with lighter washes. His hands are clasped together in front of him, holding a small, light-colored, somewhat spherical object. A vertical column of black characters is visible on the right side of the painting, near the man's shoulder. A monochromatic portrait with delicate brushwork.

alt_text: A long procession of numerous small figures carrying elaborate palanquins, banners, and ceremonial objects
long_description: A horizontal painting on a light brown background depicts a long, elaborate procession of numerous small figures and ornate objects, moving from left to right. The procession is arranged in two main, parallel lines across the canvas. In the upper line, starting from the left, a group of figures in varied robes of red, blue, green, and brown wear distinct hats. Some carry tall, multi-tiered, umbrella-like structures adorned with patterned fabrics in blue, white, and red. Following them is a large, green, domed palanquin or carriage, supported by multiple bearers. This is succeeded by more figures, some in white robes, and a rectangular, covered structure. The upper line culminates on the right with a very large, ornate red palanquin or carriage. This grand structure is richly decorated with gold and blue patterns and topped with a prominent, flaming, pearl-like ornament. It is carried by many figures and flanked by others holding tall poles with small flags or spear-like finials. The lower line, positioned below the upper, also begins on the left with figures carrying similar tiered, umbrella-like structures. Next are several figures holding tall, white, cylindrical lanterns or poles. Further to the right, a group of figures carries large, rectangular red banners, each displaying black characters. The figures throughout the procession are depicted with simple, stylized forms and minimal facial details. The overall color palette is composed of muted reds, blues, greens, browns, and whites against the plain, light brown ground.

alt_text: A large, golden-skinned figure with a green headdress sits among many smaller figures and mythical creatures
long_description: A large central figure is surrounded by numerous smaller figures and mythical creatures against a dark blue background. The central figure has a prominent, round, golden-skinned face with wide eyes and a small mouth. This figure wears an elaborate green, pointed headdress with gold accents and intricate gold and patterned clothing. It holds a slender, staff-like object in its right hand and sits upon a large, blue, dragon-like creature with red and gold details. Around the central figure, many smaller figures are depicted. Some are human-like, some with multiple arms or animalistic features, and several are shown riding various animals, including horses, deer, and other fantastical beasts. These smaller figures are arranged in dense clusters, some appearing to float on clouds, while others are positioned on stylized ground elements. The color palette is dominated by shades of gold, red, blue, green, and brown, with intricate patterns and swirling cloud motifs filling the space. The composition is densely packed with elements across the entire surface.
